The vendor directly providing **PagerDuty** at **pagerduty.com** is **PagerDuty, Inc.**

### Supporting Evidence
According to the official [PagerDuty Terms of Service](https://www.pagerduty.com/terms-of-service/):
> *"THESE ONLINE TERMS OF SERVICE (“AGREEMENT”) ARE A LEGAL AGREEMENT BETWEEN CUSTOMER (AS DEFINED BELOW) AND PAGERDUTY, INC. (“PAGERDUTY”) WHICH GOVERNS CUSTOMER'S ACCESS TO OR USE OF PAGERDUTY SERVICES..."*

Additionally, the [Website Terms of Use](https://www.pagerduty.com/website-terms-of-use/) affirm:
> *"THESE WEBSITE TERMS OF USE (“TERMS”) CONTROL YOUR (“YOU” OR “YOUR”) ACCESS TO THE PAGERDUTY, INC. (“WE,” “OUR” OR “US”) WEBSITE."*
